_comment: Hand-authored content. NOT generated -- the importers never touch this file, the same way they never touch presets.json. The eighteen spells Treefolk and Firewalkers can cast between them, transcribed from the full rules pp. 46-51 (verified with `pdftotext -table`; -layout interleaves the two columns and pairs names with the wrong effects). `cumulative` is the rulebook's red-highlighted number, which text extraction drops entirely -- it has to be read off the rendered page. A spell with neither `effect` nor `handler` is transcribed but not implemented: `resolvesSpell` answers false and `castableSpells` never offers it, which is the same deliberate silence the `sai: 'results'` rung gives an unbuilt SAI. Every spell has one by the end of Phase 7f.

spells.name: Hailstorm
spells.text: Target any opposing army. Inflict one point of damage on the target.

spells.name: Wind Walk
spells.text: Target any army. Add four maneuver results to the target's rolls until the beginning of your next turn.

spells.name: Mirage
spells.text: Target up to five health-worth of units at any terrain. The targets make a save roll. Those that do not generate a save result are moved to their Reserve Area.

spells.name: Lightning Strike
spells.text: Target any opposing unit. The target makes a save roll. If it does not generate a save result, it is killed. A unit may not be targeted by more than one Lightning Strike per magic action.

spells.name: Ash Storm
spells.text: Target any terrain. Subtract one result from all army rolls at that terrain until the beginning of your next turn.

spells.name: Flashfire
spells.text: Target any army. During any non-maneuver army roll, the target's owner may re-roll any one unit in the target army once, ignoring the previous result. This effect lasts until the beginning of your next turn.

spells.name: Fiery Weapon
spells.text: Target any army. Add two melee or missile results to any roll the target makes until the beginning of your next turn.

spells.name: Dancing Lights
spells.text: Target any opposing army. Subtract six melee results from the target's rolls until the beginning of your next turn.

spells.name: Watery Double
spells.text: Target any army. Add one save result to the target's rolls until the beginning of your next turn.

spells.name: Accelerated Growth
spells.text: Target your DUA. When a two (or greater) health Treefolk unit is killed, you may instead exchange it with a one health Treefolk unit from your DUA. This effect lasts until the beginning of your next turn.

spells.name: Flash Flood
spells.text: Target any terrain. Reduce that terrain one step unless an opposing army at that terrain generates at least six maneuver results. A terrain may never be reduced by more than one step during a player's turn from the effects of Flash Flood.

spells.name: Wall of Fog
spells.text: Target any terrain. Subtract six missile results from any missile attack targeting an army at that terrain until the beginning of your next turn.

spells.name: Stone Skin
spells.text: Target any army. Add one save result to the target's rolls until the beginning of your next turn.

spells.name: Path
spells.text: Target one of your units at a terrain. Move the target to any other terrain where you have an army.

spells.name: Wall of Thorns
spells.text: Target any terrain not at its eighth face. Any army that successfully maneuvers that terrain takes six points of damage. The army makes a melee roll instead of a save roll. Reduce the damage taken by the number of melee results generated. This effect lasts until the beginning of your next turn.

spells.name: Transmute Rock to Mud
spells.text: Target any opposing army. Subtract six maneuver results from the target's rolls until the beginning of your next turn.

spells.name: Resurrect Dead
spells.text: Target one health-worth of units in your DUA that contains the element of magic used to cast this spell. Return the targets to the casting army. Multiple castings of this spell targeting a single unit must all use the same element of magic.

spells.name: Summon Dragon
spells.text: Target any terrain. Summon one dragon that contains the element used to cast this spell from any Summoning Pool or terrain to the target terrain.
